items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: Yeah, when he was with Joe Oliver.

ctx.x: You mean Papa Celeste? Yeah, that's right. And Jelly Roll too I think the same thing.
Yeah, when he was with Joe Oliver. He played the saxophone. I see.

Yeah so he would be more famous as a saxophone player then I guess. That's right, he would. The way you say it and everything it looks like. You must have played with somebody else in the 20s, or you say you had some other places, you had your own band.
